Can we use Google Analytics to count visits and see how the quiz is used? Privacy details

Privacy & advertising

Updated October 7, 2026.

Quiz answers

Your budget, recipient choice, age band, interests, and gift-style answers stay in the page’s memory. We do not send them to our server, save them in cookies or browser storage, or pass them to Google for ad targeting. Reloading resets them. The age question refers to the person receiving the gift.

Google Analytics

If you allow analytics, we use Google Analytics to measure visits, quiz starts, completed quizzes, and clicks on Amazon links. Click events include the gift identifier and whether the link opens a product or a search. We do not send your individual quiz answers as analytics event fields.

Google may process cookies, device and browser information, referring pages, page views, and interactions to produce these reports. We have disabled Google signals and advertising personalization in our analytics settings. Read how Google uses data from partner sites.

Analytics starts after you choose “Allow.” Choose “No thanks” to keep it off. You can change your choice using “Tracking choices” in the header or footer. We remember that choice in your browser for six months. Turning analytics off stops further collection through our tag and clears its first-party cookies; previously collected data may remain in Google Analytics.

Accounts and hosting

We have no visitor accounts, email sign-up, or order processing. The hosting provider may process ordinary request information, including IP addresses and browser information, to deliver and secure the site. Read OpenAI’s Privacy Policy for the hosting provider’s practices.

Shopping links

Amazon links may include an affiliate tracking ID. Following one sends you to Amazon, which can process your activity and use cookies under its own policies. We do not receive your Amazon payment details or the quiz answers through that link. Read Amazon’s Privacy Notice. Amazon and the seller control checkout and fulfillment.

Google advertising on the buying guides

Only the complete buying guides load the Google AdSense advertising script. They have a labeled banner below the article. Google and its advertising partners may collect or use information such as IP addresses, browser or device information, cookies, web beacons, and other identifiers to provide, measure, secure, and personalize advertising where permitted.

Third parties may place and read cookies on your browser or use web beacons and IP addresses as a result of ad serving. Google’s advertising cookies allow Google and its partners to tailor ads based on visits to this and other websites. Ad delivery depends on account approval, available advertising, applicable consent choices, and browser settings.

Your choices

Where applicable, the consent message configured through Google AdSense presents advertising privacy choices. You can also manage personalized advertising in Google My Ad Center, read how Google uses data from partner sites, and review participating vendors’ choices at YourAdChoices. Your browser can control cookies. Opting out of personalization does not necessarily stop advertising or all processing needed to deliver it.

Google’s consent message handles your advertising privacy choices separately from the quiz.

Audience and updates

This service is intended for adult gift shoppers and is not directed to children under 13. We do not knowingly collect children’s account or contact information. This page will be revised when the site’s data practices change. We currently have no public support inbox or contact form.
